title: Stop redundant Paper Live-shadow reconciliation after final fill synchronization
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Проверь сервер, ставки, логи и канселы живых ставок

scope.goal: Remove the verified repeated Paper/Live-shadow settlement synchronization errors without changing order placement, fill accounting, settlement accounting, or Live cancellation behavior.
inScope: In LiveTradingProcessor, keep the existing Paper/Live shape validation and recognize a Paper shadow whose execution_source is already paper_live_shadow_actual_fill as already synchronized for a positive terminal Live fill.
Do not call PaperLiveShadowFillReconciler again for that already-synchronized final fill; continue the existing decision-link update and independent Live settlement path.

Update focused unit coverage so an already-synchronized and already-settled Paper shadow produces no PaperLiveShadowSettlementSync Error, performs no second fill reconciliation, leaves Paper fill/position accounting unchanged, and still applies the Live settlement exactly once.
Run focused Live-trading tests and a Release solution build using only the marked D:/CodexTemp run for disposable outputs.
outOfScope: Changing the frozen execution intent, Live/Paper order side, size, price, notional, order type, time-in-force, fill inference, fees, PnL, balance settlement, lost-counter behavior, expiry, cancellation, or risk rules.
Suppressing shape mismatches, missing Paper shadows, unsynchronized fills, copied-leader exit conflicts, or any other genuine reconciliation failure.

Retrying, bypassing, or otherwise changing handling of the Polymarket CLOB response HTTP 503: trading is disabled; no local request-construction or dispatch defect was established for those responses.

Changing Binance/OKX/Polymarket market-data behavior, PostgreSQL deadlock handling, queue scheduling, schema, migrations, database rows, strategies, orders, configuration, service state, deployment, or Production.
scope.periodOrFilter: The shared Paper/Live-shadow synchronization path for Live orders whose linked Paper order is already durably marked paper_live_shadow_actual_fill; runtime evidence is the two successful post-deploy Live orders observed on 2026-09-01/02 UTC.
scope.firstVerification: Trace the exact Product error rows through LiveTradingProcessor.TrySyncPaperShadowBeforeLiveSettlementAsync, SyncPaperShadowAsync, PaperLiveShadowFillReconciler, and the repository settled-position guard before editing.

requirements.text: Eliminate redundant reconciliation errors for Paper shadows that have already copied the final Live fill, while preserving all genuine reconciliation checks and Live settlement behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: SyncPaperShadowAsync still validates the linked Paper and Live order shape before deciding that synchronization is already complete.
When the Live order has a positive filled size and the linked Paper order execution_source is paper_live_shadow_actual_fill, PaperLiveShadowFillReconciler is not called again.
The already-synchronized path still updates the existing Paper/Live-shadow decision links and does not alter the Paper order, fill, position, or settlement rows.
A matched Live order whose Paper shadow was already synchronized and settled still receives its Live balance settlement exactly once and produces no PaperLiveShadowSettlementSync Error event.
Paper shadows not durably marked paper_live_shadow_actual_fill retain the existing reconciliation behavior and existing genuine failures remain visible.

verification.command: dotnet test tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --filter FullyQualifiedName~LiveTradingGatingTests using --artifacts-path and --results-directory below the active marked D:/CodexTemp run
verification.expected: All focused LiveTradingGatingTests pass, including the already-synchronized settled-shadow regression and existing reconciliation/shape/cancellation coverage.

verification.command: dotnet build PolyCopyTrader.sln --configuration Release using --artifacts-path below the active marked D:/CodexTemp run
verification.expected: The Release solution build completes with zero errors.

verification.command: Inspect the final diff, run git diff --check, run requirement-contract WorkingTree and Staged validation, and obtain independent semantic review against both verbatim prompts, the approved contract, implementation, and verification evidence.
verification.expected: Only the approved processor/test behavior changes; mechanical gates pass and the independent reviewer returns PASS with no findings.
